Lead to deregistration

event(s): UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT message via CAG cell

conditions: The entry for the registered PLMN in the received "CAG information list" includes an "indication that the UE is only allowed to access 5GS via CAG cells"
actions: Apply the PLMN selection process defined in 3GPP TS 23.122 [5] with the updated "CAG information list"
